 Prayer :

Civil Miscellaneous Appeal filed under Section 173 of Moto
 Vehicles Act, 1988, against the judgment and decree in M.C.O.P.No.3
 of 2022 dated 03.10.2023, on the file of the Motor Accident Claims
 Tribunal, Special District Judge, Salem.
For Appellant(s) : Mr.R.Navaneetha

For Respondent(s) : Mrs.R.Sreevi
 Judgment

This appeal is filed by the appellants challenging the order dated 03.10.2023 passed in M.C.O.P.No.328 of 2022 on the file of Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal/Special District Judge,
Salem.

entities.text:
Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal/Special District Judge,
Salem
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2.For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to as per their ranking before the Tribunal.
3.The petitioners are the claimants, first respondent is the owner of the vehicle and second respondent is the Insurance Company before the Tribunal.

4.The brief facts of the case are as follows:
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

( Uploaded on: 08/09/2025 08:23:45 pm ) On 04.12.2021 at about 6.30 a.m, when the deceased Kandhasami was travelling as a pillion rider in the two wheeler bearing Registration No.TN-30-AP-9184 driven by one Suresh from Salem to Covai Main Road near Rakkipatti bus stand at that time, a lorry bearing Registration No.TN-66-AF-6499 driven by its driver in a rash and negligent manner and hit behind the two wheeler.
Due to the accident, the said Kandhasami sustained grievous injuries all over the body and died on the spot.
The petitioners filed a claim petition before the Tribunal in M.C.O.P.No.328 of 2022, the Tribunal awarded a sum of Rs.14,05,000/- as compensation.

Aggrieved by the same,
the present appeal has been filed.

5.Learned counsel appearing for the appellants submitted that the accident occurred only due to rash and negligent driving by the driver of the lorry and due to which, the first appellant's husband died on the spot.
He further submitted that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is very meagre and hence, he filed the present appeal for enhancement.

6.Learned counsel appearing for the second respondent submitted that Tribunal after considering the oral and documentary evidence has https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on:
08/09/2025 08:23:45 pm ) awarded the compensation which is just and reasonable and no interference is required by this Court.
Hence, she prayed for dismissal of the appeal.

Kamala vs M/S.S.S.Road Lines on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82962866/
2
7.Heard learned counsel appearing for the appellants, learned counsel for the second respondent and perused the materials available on record.
8.Before the Tribunal, the petitioner was examined as PW1 and on the side of the petitioners, 13 documents were marked as Exs.P1 to P13.
On the side of the respondents, no oral and documentary evidence were adduced.

9.The Tribunal after elaborately discussing the factual aspects awarded a sum of Rs.12,60,000/- for loss of income, Rs.80,000/- for loss of love and affection, Rs.40,000/- for loss of consortium,
Rs.25,000/- for funeral expenses and arrived at a total compensation of Rs.14,05,000/-
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/09/2025 08:23:45 pm ) with interest at the rate of 7.5% p.a. from the date of petition till the date of realization.
10.On perusal of the records, it is seen that the petitioner was aged 44 years and was working in powerloom at the time of the accident.
11.The amount awarded under the heads loss of consortium in the opinion of this Court is just and reasonable and the same is confirmed.

The amount awarded under the heads loss of love & affection and funeral expenses, in the opinion of this Court is very high and this Court is inclined to reduce the amount awarded under the said heads.
Accordingly, the amount awarded under the head loss of love and affection is reduced to Rs.60,000/- from Rs.80,000/- (Rs.20,000/- x 3).
Accordingly, the amount awarded under the head funeral expenses is reduced to Rs.16,500/- from Rs.25,000/-.
The amount awarded under the head loss of income, in the opinion of this Court is very meagre and this Court is inclined to enhance the amount under the said head.

Accordingly, the amount awarded under the head loss of income is https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/09/2025 08:23:45 pm ) enhanced to Rs.28,35,000/- from Rs.12,60,000/- Though the Tribunal has not awarded any amount for loss of estate, this Court is inclined to award Rs.16,500/- for the loss of estate.
12.Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the submission made by the learned counsel for the appellants

sentences.text: 15.The second respondent Insurance Company is directed to deposit the modified/enhanced award amount before the Tribunal within a period of 8 weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.

On such deposit being made, the appellants/claimants 1, 2 and 4 are permitted to withdraw the amount along with accrued interest and proportionate costs, after deducting the amount already withdrawn, if any, on making proper and necessary application before the Tribunal.

If https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/09/2025 08:23:45 pm ) the third appellant/claimant is still minor, his share shall be kept in an interest yielding fixed deposit with anyone of the Nationalized Bank, initially, for a period of three years to be renewed at periodic intervals until he attains majority and the interest derived from out of the said share of the minor shall be paid to the first appellant/mother every quarter to be utilized for the welfare of the said minor.
The other directions issued by the Tribunal with regard to the mode of payment of compensation and apportionment remain unaltered.
16.The appellants/claimants shall not be entitled to any interest for the period of delay, if any, in filing the appeal.
The appellants/claimants are directed to pay the requisite Court fee for the enhanced compensation amount, if required.

The Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/Special District Judge, Salem shall disburse the enhanced amount upon production of certified copy showing proof of payment of Court fee by the appellants/claimants.
